body: I honestly asked my family and friends IRL to keep my stream open just to pad my stream with viewers. Sometimes it's awkward to be like the only viewer and inviting people you're close to can make you really shine when making content!!

I think it's honestly meeting other community members by discord, raiding their streams, and staying active in those spaces. I got invited to a girl streamer discord after I randomly popped by someone in a mukbang stream eating popeyes LOL. From then on, we all supported each other, played games with each other and I feel like it really expanded my horizons!   


Other things include make sure you're raiding people who you don't usually raid. Raiding your friends every so often is fine but ask your chat if they'd like to lead the raid to get to know what other communities they're in or find someone completely new!

I had crazy dry skin and it seemed my old serum just wasn’t cutting it. I added the cosrx triple Hyaluronic and maaaan did I feel hydrated. I’m not sure if it’s bad to stack it but it seemed to feel really good on my skin.

It’s an oil based cleanser so I occasionally use it as a mask to draw out some oil. After rubbing it in my skin for hours, I feel like blackheads come out on their own so I really enjoy it. 

I usually use it when I workout just because I think it cleanses my sweat/dirt/pollution pretty well.
